q: What is the general basis of the architect's minimum basic fee?
n: Per the MST answer key: Type of structure.

q: What should NOT be a basis of the architect's fee?
n: Fees aren't set by friendship.

q: An architect was hired by a client to design a condominium located in a commercial area, but no formal contract was signed. After several meetings, the architect produced a schematic design, which was subsequently approved. However, the client decided to no longer proceed with the architect. How much compensation is the architect entitled to?
o: 15% of contract price plus 5% for breach of contract
n: Per the MST answer key: Free because there's no contract.

q: An architect was commissioned to design a residential project with a contract stipulating full payment upon completion of construction. Everything worked out until the project was finished, but the owner ran out of budget to start the construction. How much is the architect entitled to collect legally?
n: Per the MST answer key: 90%.

q: Aclient is very happy with the design plans made for his house. He decides to use the same design for his son's house. How much will the client pay the architect for the second house?
n: SPP Doc 202 residential repeat units: units 2 to 10 are charged 60% of the first unit's fee.

q: If the client decides to hire the architect for Design-Build by administration, how much additional fee should the architect charge in addition to the original 10%?
n: Per the MST answer key: 7%.

q: What is the compensation for long-term relations in a project?
n: Per the MST answer key: Professional fee & expenses.

q: What method of compensation has a continuing relationship with the architect?
n: Per the MST answer key: Professional fee & expenses.

q: What method of payment is used where there is a continuing relationship involving a series of projects?
n: Per the MST answer key: None of the above.

q: How is a building and facilities administration architect paid?
o: Percentage of gross rentals, maintenance and security fees
n: SPP 205.

q: How many percent should the Architect be compensated after the Contract Document Phase even if the project has not commenced?
n: Per the MST answer key: None of the above.

q: A project is on hold for a year for lack of funds. When should you bill for the contract documents?
n: The fee is earned when the phase is delivered.

q: What is the basis of the Building Administration fee?
o: Percentage of gross rentals, maintenance, and security fees
n: Building administration may be paid as a percentage of gross rentals or as a monthly fee.

q: Design build by maximum cost, how much is the architect remunerated?
o: Built in the max cost exclusive of architectural registration fee
Lump sum inclusive of architectural fee
n: Per the MST answer key: Built in the max cost exclusive of architectural registration fee.

q: How much is the Minimum basic fee from the PCC for Simple Projects without partitions, such as Hangars?
n: Per the MST answer key: 5%.

q: For repetitive designs, what is the fee for each unit after the third?
n: Per the MST answer key: None of the above.

q: When is the Professional Tax Receipt due each year?
n: On or before January 31.

q: In which month are business permits usually renewed?
n: The first month of the year.

q: What is the first step in renewing a business permit?
n: The barangay clears first.

q: When is the annual income tax return due?
n: For calendar-year filers.

q: What is the standard VAT rate in the Philippines?
n: 12% under the NIRC.

q: An owner authorizes the architect to act for him through a:
n: An SPA covers specific acts.

q: As per the LGU code, the maximum amount a professional can pay for their Community Tax Certificate (CEDULA) io, 2.
n: Per the MST answer key: Php 5,000.00.

q: For a replacement PRC ID, besides the fee, you must present a:
n: An affidavit of loss is required.

q: As an Architect, you have a responsibility to your staff and fellow architects. Which of the following would best show this?
o: Be an example of how to become a good professional
Train them to be good in their profession
n: Per the MST answer key: Train them to be good in their profession.

q: How should an architect compensate subordinates?
n: Fair pay for the work.

q: For the registration of an architectural corporation, where would you go first?
n: Per the MST answer key: SEC.

q: If planning to set up a corporation before going to SEC, where should you get an endorsement?
n: Per the MST answer key: PRC.

q: What advantage does 3D and computer graphics give architects and clients?
n: Clients see the design before it's built.

q: What is the size of the basic drawing submitted to the OBO for Building Permit applications?
n: Per the MST answer key: Alsize.

q: The architect has chosen a winning bidder, but the owner doesn't approve. What is the architect's course of action?
n: Per the MST answer key: Re-bid.

q: What must be the character of an architect nowadays?
n: Per the MST answer key: Flexible in design.

q: After passing the LEA, what should the new architect do?
n: Registration follows the oath.

q: What is the standard size of architectural drawings?
n: Philippine architectural sheets are commonly 20 × 30 in.

q: What scale or full-size model is used for teaching, demonstration, evaluation or promotion?
n: A mock-up.

q: A rule of thumb used for estimating materials on a residential project:
n: Per the MST answer key: 70% of project construction.
